newsitem.title: USA: Murdoch's News Corp. in Japanese music venture.
newsitem.headline: Murdoch's News Corp. in Japanese music venture.

text.p: News Corp. has created a joint venture company with Japanese recording artist and producer Tetsuya Komuro, a spokeswoman for News Corp. said Wednesday.
One source close to the deal said the new company will be a music and multimedia company that will be launched in Asia and eventually expand worldwide.

Lachlan Murdoch, managing director of News Ltd. and deputy chairman of Star TV, both subsidiaries of media mogul Rupert Murdoch's News Corp., and Tetsuya Komuro were to announce the venture on Friday in Los Angeles.
The source said it is believed that Star TV, a satellite television company based in Hong Kong, will serve as distribution arm for the venture.
